task_context.reference_solution: Since $\angle RIP$ is inscribed in arc $RP$, the measure of arc $RP$ is $2\angle RIP = 72^\circ$.  Therefore, arc $RP$ is $\frac{72}{360} =\frac15$ of the circumference of the whole circle.  The circle's circumference is $2OR\pi = 20\pi$ cm, so the length of arc $RP$ is $\frac15\cdot 20\pi = \boxed{4\pi}$ cm.
